reviews.text: In stock. This app is my life saver. I wouldn’t not be able to live without it. My skin is the best it’s ever been because I know what I can and cannot use.
Life saver. I’m ecstatic to have have this app! It calms the anxiety I was experiencing not knowing which products I could or could not use.

Bad information overwhelming an otherwise great user experience. It seems like their product ingredients and allergens is very often incorrect, making their good user experience useless. I’ve reported (with no response) numerous errors resulting in false positives, where the app says a product is unsafe for a list of allergens, based on ingredients the product does not have, whether as reported on the packaging, product web site, or even the ingredients SkinSAFE lists. I’d love to hear from the product team about why there are so many apparent errors, with a commitment to update the app, and happy to replace this review if I’m mistaken.

100 to a product containing TALC?!!!. Did this app not get the memo that most all talc contains asbestos?!!!! I am in shock they would give a 100 rating to something containing it! Look it up if you don't agree! Deleting this app and not believing a word it says cause clearly they are not up to date on harmful ingredients in makeup products! UPDATE your app or do some more research!
Incredibly helpful. This app is so incredibly helpful for those of us with multiple allergies to figure out what products are safe!

Love the concept, hate the app. I’ve had this app for around 4.5 years now and I absolutely love the concept and have a direct medical need to use it frequently and with ALL my products, however the app sucks so bad. It logs you out all the time, then even when I save my passwords it tells me it’s wrong, when I try to reset my password I go through the whole process then go back to log in and it says “request cancelled” ?? Then I try to input my new password and it’s “incorrect”. Nothing works to get back into this app. And when I’m lucky enough to get in, I set my biometrics to use my face but it tells me it’s expired and I have to log back in and then logs me out again. It’s incredibly frustrating.
Never answer email.. I have sent emails. I never get a response. I paid for a year they have it for a month. App is good to use so you can find what you can use.

💲All they want is MONEY ❗️. I have had various unexplained rashes and itchy patches since I was a teen. I am almost 70 now! Told to try numerous tactics to try and alleviate them. Everything from OTC dandruff ‘remedies’ to various prescriptions along the way. I finally had a ALLERGY PATCH TEST done by a dermatologist and it identified 4 skin ingredients that irritate my skin. The dermatologist recommended this website for checking products’ ingredients so I can avoid my allergies. WONDERFUL! Finally on the right track, or so I thought. I was scanning multiple products at the store and the many things that I already owned. Only had been on this site for about 2 weeks when a pop up said that I had reached their limit for the number of scans, and that I was now limited to 1scan per day☹️ Of course I was ‘encouraged’ of get the premium version of the app, for a fee. Now, a few days later, I can’t even view the products that I have already scanned without ‘upgrading’ to the paid version of the app❗️. 😡 
The Dermatologist did not mention that the “FREE” app only works for a small amount of time. Nor does the App Store site provide any sort of information except “IN APP PURCHASES”. 
I DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS APP❗️❗️(Especially now that it’s holding my already scanned product searches hostage unless I pay up)
Great At Home. The app works great at home. But in the grocery store, it appeared to be blocked.

Camera and Product Avaiability. Your App is a life saver! But-Please improve your camera and zoom & focus capabilities for adding products 
And so many products I finally find safe for me are “No longer available” Some are in Europe. Any chance to link European linked sites for ordering products?
Can’t live without it. Skinsafe is best, my app of the year! Easy to use, simply lifesaver. Thank you for Skinsafe. 💖

Lacks any value in free mode. I just want a basic app to help me compare a small list of allergies to products. That’s not available without a subscription. I might consider paying for value-add if the base app wasn’t bait.
Changing to 5 stars. Because they brought back the lists for the free version. I do wish it was more affordable but it really is a big help!

Lifesaver. I paid for the subscription and being able to instantly scan something while shopping and know if it’s safe for me is incredible. My only suggestions would be 1) adding more filters of where a product is available (ex Sephora and Ulta), and 2) it would be nice if there was a scale of some sort because my 100% safe products are extremely limited but there are many products that have TRACE amounts of only one of my allergen and would likely not cause a reaction
Customer service non-existent. I’ve attempted to contact them three times for a code. No response. It’s been a month and a half.

Terrible Company. This app is a joke. Apparently there are zero products safe for me. Indicates ingredients not even listed on products. Contacted companies directly and the app is WRONG over and over. Aldo terrible customer service I have contacted them 3 times with zero response. They want your money but are zero help. Save your money or use the one approved by ACDS!! Much more accurate!

Don’t buy premium. This would be a fantastic app for people with skin allergies, but unfortunately you have to buy premium to see what specific ingredients the product contains that you may be allergic too, at least I think that’s how it works. I wouldn’t know because I purchased premium but nothing has changed as far as what I could see when I had the free version and it still prompts me to purchase premium when I try to go deeper into the app. And don’t bother with CS, they will reply once and then forget you ever existed without resolving the problem.
Staying healthy. I’ve been trying to make sure all products I use are heathy and safe. This app is helping.

I really want to like it. This is a product that is so desperately needed. Unfortunately, in its current iteration, it is NOT worth the money. 

Here are some of the issues I’ve run into:

Search:
Their search function could not be worse if it tried. If I search “Vanicream cleanser” it says no results. But if I scan my Vanicream daily facial cleanser’s barcode, it’ll show up. But then if I favorite or try to add it to my “use daily” list, it won’t show up. You can type in the exact name of a product word for word and it will not be found in the search but will then pop up when you’re browsing. Truly. Have never encountered a product search that was so dysfunctional. 

Adding products:
If I scan a barcode and the product doesn’t come up, I’m rarely asked if I want to add it to have them analyze, despite that being an advertised feature. 

Product coverage:
Super basic, ubiquitous products are not included. Talking Vanicream, Neutrogena, Burt’s Bees level stuff. Same with higher end popular skincare brands, like Peter Thomas Roth. 

Ingredients lists:
They’re not always complete. I cross referenced a couple and found they don’t have every ingredient listed. Given what this app advertises as its purpose, this is dangerous and irresponsible. 

Disappearing items:
As mentioned, favorited items or items added to your lists will fully disappear. This is especially concerning when you’re adding items to the “got a reaction” bucket. 

Got a reaction bucket:
Since they advertise this as AI, I for some reason thought I’d get insights by adding things to the list of products I got a reaction from. No such luck. What a bummer. 

Cross your fingers they get their ish together because this is a great idea. It’s just terrible execution.

Really bad info. Be very careful with this. The information is very limited and does not educate users about the negative aspects of ingredients. There are so many missing capabilities that it certainly shouldn’t cost what the app developer charges. Simple examples is to let the user scan the ingredients on the product label and provide an immediate analysis of the known ingredients and flag those that are unknown. Elementary solution, it’s not there. Just an overpriced, poorly designed app.

Great app. This app is great. One thing that seems to be missing is the ability to filter products based on an ingredient you cannot use (feature that is available from the desktop site). It would also be great if you could filter by more than one ingredient also. I plan to ask my allergist about a code, but I know we will find more things. I am allergic to, and I’m not sure there is a way to update on my own.
No support. There is no phone support. The individualized safe for me code cannot be inputted into the app.

Sometimes confusing. I’m sure they are still working some bugs out with this app. And unfortunately, some of the bugs are leaving me lacking confidence in the information I am provided from it.

Sometimes I will look up a product in their “explore” option and it will tell me the product is OK for me. But if I scan the barcode on the product., It will tell me it is not OK for me. 😵‍💫

Or in some cases like with laundry detergent the app will tell me that the 80 load version of the product is OK but the exact same product in the 30 load version is not. 

They need to clean up their database.
Confusing age requirements. The app is overall pretty good but before you download the app, it says that the age requirement is 4+, but once you download it it asks to make sure you are over 18???
It always says 91. I feel like it is not accurate because everything I have scanned is a 91 so I don’t think it’s very true

Helped find safe products. This app has definitely helped me find products I can use. My biggest complaint is they don’t remove discontinued products from their database. I started paying for the app hoping my support would aide in this issue but no change so far. I’m not sure I’ll keep paying.

Making better. If you ask me the only way to make it, five stars in my opinion would be able to scan the product not the barcode because somethings don’t have the barcode and if they don’t have the barcode, did you need the box and I don’t have the box to some stuff
.. Doesn’t cost anything and very accurate!

Celiac disease persons night. I downloaded this app to see if my products I’m using have gluten in them. I have celiac disease so I’m very allergic to gluten. I trusted this app and turns out that it doesn’t accurately tell you whether products are gluten-free or not. I highly suggest you doing your own research as I have done because this app absolutely is lying and misleading. seems to me that these are just opinion based reviews instead of science based reviews or accurate safety of products. if I could give zero stars, I would.

Response to skinsafes response: let me get this straight, your solution is for me to pay more for your app that isn’t accurate? Your app says Monday hair care products are all gluten-free. Your app also specifically is advertised as helping people with allergies. Cross-contamination was never the issue. I understand those risks. The Monday hair care product that I used said wheat protein on the front of it and your app said differently. Do yourself a favor and do not use this app!!!
Awful. This app takes you down rabbit holes and there’s no way to get back to home. Also, there’s no explanation of the chemicals.

Inaccurate info, glitchy. If you look on their website vs. the app, the information is different, rendering it worthless if you have severe skin allergies like I do. Also, if I hadn’t double-checked their work, I would’ve continued to have a horrible reaction because I trusted their site. It’s embarrassing that this comes from the Mayo Clinic and there are potentially life-threatening discrepancies on here. I even have the paid version! Also, right now you can’t scroll down in the app, at all! Worthless.

App touch sensitivity. Can’t navigate through products. Touch sensitivity is too high and does not allow for scrolling through lists of products. Please update app with either a scroll bar or lower touch sensitivity for scrolling rather than selecting the item. In addition, when browsing categories I cannot choose a refined category. Example: I pick sunscreen, then cannot choose any of the five further categories(lips, facial, body, etc).
App freezes. I am really frustrated with this app. It keeps freezing

So buggy I can’t believe I wasted $50. This app is so buggy. I can’t believe no longer log in. I’ve deleted and reinstalled the app. I’ve updated it and reached out to customer service and they just keep telling me to delete and reinstall again. Don’t waste your money.
Needs work. This app is very helpful but has a lot of bugs. I tried contacting customer service to receive an email saying they basically help premium members first!

Yuck. I used this when it was web based. It was very helpful. I really need to find clean products, but I deleted this app after 5 minutes. I don’t want to stand and scan products. I want to search a database and have choices appear. It’s not intuitive. It needs less of an ad and more actual instructions under “how does this work”. I have no patience for this.
about the app!. i personally love the app because you can see things that will help your skin and things you can buy i would recommend it download it now!!

Buggy. I have been a user for years and I love this app. I recommend it for new moms and eczema sufferers alike. But lately the app just doesn’t work. Searches don’t work. It shows a blank screen on most sections of the app. I tried it based on the web as well and got the same results. Not good, but hopefully temporary?
Great App. I love Skin Safe I can check to see if products are safe for me instantly.
Highly Recommend. This app makes looking for products that are safe for my loved one so so so easy!! It is super helpful and has already saved me countless hours of time.
Won’t load product details. The app won’t load product pages. The web page works fine. Great info, if it loads.

Used to work well. This app has gone downhill. It used to work but now the explore page is empty, no products show up when searching, and the home page is empty. It’s like it’s been gutted out. What a disappointment.

Horrible. Why does this app never work? Why do I have to uninstall and reinstall constantly because the app just decides to stop working completely? The user interface is horrible. The search function is horrible. There’s nothing intuitive about this app. For an app with the potential to be so useful to people and provide a service no one else does, you’d think they’d spend a little more money making this app functional.

Horrible glitches. Every time I search, it will not show any results. I try closing and restarting the app and nothing helps. Very few items are listed and it takes FOREVER to find out if your submission is finished. This could be an AMAZING resource for those of us with horrible skin allergies!! Mayo Clinic, DO BETTER! Especially since I had to pay for non-existent content! I won’t purchase again!

Do not pay for a subscription!!. Was great until I paid for the subscription. The free version worked fine but I decided to see what the subscription was like. Now that I upgraded, it will not let me turn on the Safe For Me filter and nothing will load when I search. This feels like such a scam and I am incredibly disappointed.

Was Great with Potential, But Now….. This app has always been nothing but potential. In efforts to monetize it, it’s become increasingly as and decreasingly useful. Such a shame because it used to feel so helpful to folks who needed it.
App not working. This app hasn’t worked in a couple months. What a bummer as it was awesome for a while, but now useless and I paid for the annual subscription!
Too Many Bugs. App doesn’t work correctly. It only lets me save to my “Favorites” and won’t let me mark things as “Daily Use” or “Had a Reaction”, so pretty useless app.
What happened?. Nothing works in the app. Cant look up any products. What happened?
App not working for months. App is not functional at all. Hasn’t worked in months, just blank. I paid for the subscription, so I’m rather annoyed about this.

Code and search not working, support vanished after I paid. I’m not a person who writes 1 star reviews lightly, but I have been pretty baffled by how frustrating this experience ended up being. I had high hopes for this site, but I’ve had issues since day 1.

The “personal allergy code” doesn’t actually appear to be truly personalized (at least not for my allergies). I was told my code (for sodium benzoate) automatically included fragrances but could be modified to remove the extra things it was filtering out and I said yes, I ONLY needed that ingredient filtered. Some stuff is now marked safe but there are still a wide variety of ingredients that have nothing to do with my allergies being marked not safe for me?? (Agave? Salicylic acid? Neither of these are alternate forms of sodium benzoate!)

On top of that, search DOES NOT WORK. I can go directly to a product page (via a google search) and see that a product is “safe for me” yet it won’t appear in my search results on the site or in the category it belongs to.

Between this and all the extra ingredients being excluded from my results, the site is basically useless. I can barely find any products. 

During my free trial, support was responsive (though I had to send a few messages multiple times) and I was told my issues were being looked into. A week later (once my free trial ended) I asked for an update and got no reply. Another week passed, and another.

It has now been AN ENTIRE MONTH with no reply, despite my sending multiple messages using the contact form, the support email, even commenting on the IG page. It feels like they just ghosted me once my card was charged. I’ve paid for a year’s sub for a service I apparently can’t use and can’t get ANY help with.

I tried to be patient and understanding, but this is ridiculous. At this point I’ve just assumed my issues won’t be fixed and tried asking for a refund on my subscription, but of course can’t get a reply on that either. At this point I honestly wonder if I’ve just been scammed. Or at the very least, something is preventing them from receiving and/or replying to customer emails, which is just totally unacceptable for a paid service, especially when customers encounter significant bugs from the start.

It has been stressful enough trying to replace most of the products I own due to a severe allergy, and this app that was supposed to make it easier instead caused additional stress. I wanted so badly for this to work out but as-is I do not recommend it.
Isn’t working. I use to use this app often and though it didn’t have all the products, it had most standard items. Well it seems it no longer works? App is blank and there are no updates…

Stopped working. I relied on this and it completely stopped working. My dermatologist switched from ACDS to this. It worked fine for awhile, but now I can’t search for anything, apply filters and no products are showing up at all. I even updated, but nothing was fixed. I also don’t understand the subscription model, seems ways too pricey. Monthly subscription really add up.

Worth Every Penny!!!!!!!. This has improved since a year ago it’s better than ewg Yuma anything I’ve found and easier app new data base Thank You God I’m seriously Thankful I have health reasons for needing this safe nontoxic cosmetic information.
Finally some help with products. I have been wasting so much time skimming through ingredients. This app has changed my life. Thank you!

App fixed!. Recently left a review with concern over the refine & sort by feature not working correctly on my phone. The next update included a correction for this. I have never had a company actually pay attention to a complaint like that and correct it. They corrected it faster than I could even respond to their inquiry about my issue. I was not expecting someone to reach out about it, so I was not actively looking in my messages. Anyways, the point
is I can now use this app on the go and the refining feature works flawlessly! Thanks! I really depend on this app for a quick reference. Now that I can use the app fully it is worth every penny! 
I have changed almost all products I was previously using, SkinSafe really made that transition possible. Having a list of 100 ingredients you are allergic to, each with 100 different names, makes it difficult to constantly cross check everything, but SkinSafe does that for you, and that’s invaluable. It has saved me so much time.

I haven’t had any issues with the accuracy of ingredients, they seem to update those as well, quite frequently.
All the irritation and breakouts I was experiencing before are now completed cleared. Now I use the app mostly for maintenance for when my products are out of stock, it helps find an alternative. If I scan an item that ends up not being safe for me, SkinSafe shows you similar products that are safe, which is great! Anyway thanks again for the update!

Incredibly helpful. I recently got diagnosed with allergies to 14 ingredients found in many products. My doctor told me about SkinSAFE and it has not only been a lifesaver, but also a time-saver for me. I love how easy and simple it is to use. I upgraded to the paid version and it is well worth $60/year ($5/month)…in my opinion it’s a bargain! I highly recommend!

Needs work. As a newer eczema sufferer this app is helpful but there are a few features I wish it had. I’m a UX designer for reference so these aren’t just from a user perspective.
- Ability to add a product without scanning: this would be with a credible link, photo, and the ingredient list. I think this would increase the availability for people to add products and be more helpful in the long run. 
- The date the product was added: ingredients change in products all the time, and it would be helpful to know when a product was updated or validated, or both, so we can see how accurate the ingredients are today. If the product is added later with a different list, the product could just update accordingly.
- On the note of ingredient lists, I wish it would keep the list as a normal list, and in order that they’re listed on the product. 
- In terms of the tags/call outs: if it says it’s not safe for eyelids let’s say, it would be helpful for the app to identify which ingredient(s) are getting flagged. This is helpful so we don’t have to click on each individual ingredient.

Very helpful & good start. I just got a diagnosis about my skin allergies. I didn’t know to ask my doctor about a skin code so I just emailed customer service about what I was allergic to and they helped add it to my account. Now I can see if something won’t work for me. Thank you for helping me get on the right path!

I would like it if the prices could be seen when you are scrolling through options. I know you have to buy from different places but even an estimate would be helpful. Also, if you could favorite the brands you like so you can keep up with their products and just look at those stores.
The app does not even open.. There was no QR scanner.

I used to love this app. I used to love this app and I would recommend it to everyone! I even got my dermatologist to recommend it to other patients. But now it’s pretty terrible. Features that used to be free are now behind a subscription paywall. I understand that the app needs to make money, but you should add new features instead of screwing over loyal users. Additionally, it is now IMPOSSIBLE to search for products. I tried to search for my shampoo, Biolage Ultra Hydrosource, a well known and popular brand, and the app found zero results in the search. I know for a fact that this product is in the SkinSafe database because I have looked up its ingredients on the app before. Unfortunately, given the many negative changes to this app, I will probably stop using it and stop recommending it to other people.

Monetized now and crappy. This used to be free and it would tell you why something wasn’t safe for you for free, you could search or request to add as many products as you needed to search in a month for free (and they’d get back to you within 2-3 days). It was the BEST app for checking things against my allergies. Now, like everything, they want you to subscribe. There’s no option for a lifetime plan, just stupid subscription services in order to see which ingredients are unsafe for you in a product (helpful since some ingredients can go by dozens of different names), and to check more than 3 items they don’t have listed per month. I am SOOOO sick of subscription culture and people trying to monetize things on a monthly basis, but when it’s healthcare-related, it’s especially disgusting/despicable.

AWFUL CUSTOMER SERVICE. If I could give this app a zero I would. I have had this app for over three months and I still can’t use it because the customer service is so terrible. I’ve sent 8 emails. The only way you can get in touch with somebody is to fill out their submittal form, it’s the only time I get a response. My last email I told them I want a refund, she told me she hasn’t received any of my emails. I’m responding to THEIR emails! I asked if there was a different email to respond to. No response. If ur doctor does not subscribe to their app basically it’s useless. You need a special code, but they say that they can add your allergies in if your dr isn’t affiliated. That’s all I need. But after three months of dealing with this, I just want my money back.

Sorting. The reason why I bought this app is because of my contact dermatitis. I need a product that is rated 100%. This app does not default to Top score. It does not default to your chosen option of Top Score. If you are on the Top Score sorting and clicked on a product or put them in your favorites, guaranteed, the display will resort back to whatever algorithm this app has. Why pay and subscribe to an app that can’t even default to your own preferences? I am sure the algorithm is whoever is your sponsor because it is not even alpha -arranged or rating arranged. Can you please fix this?

They are now paywalling your health. The app was already clunky before and now they are charging you every month just to see what ingredient is not safe for you. A feature that was previously free and how they created their initial user base in the first place. Dermatologists need to start recommending different apps.
Subscription now??. This app was a great referral my doctor gave me since almost everything is bad for my skin, but now you have to pay for a subscription? Whatever man. Anything to make money right?

deceptive. at startup, the app tries to trick you into signing up for a subscription. sure, there's a small 'x' on the corner. still feels dirty. 
any worthwhile feature is behind a paywall, even while in "trial period". the point of a trial period is to give the consumer the ability to gauge whether the product is worth their money.

Updated app to find I don’t have the same features. I recently updated the application and noticed that a lot of the features I depended upon are now behind a paywall. These features used to be free! I'm curious about the reason for this change as I feel the Mayo Clinic should not promote this to patients anymore.

I also visited the website and they are promoting the Mayo Clinic as a developer for the pay subscription. I will be talking to my dermatologist and the Mayo Clinic. This is simply bait and switch or the application/Mayo Clinic should have been upfront about the fact that what they were recommending to patients was only a promotional offer.

Premium subscription model makes it useless. I just switched to an iPhone and re-downloaded this app, only to find that the iOS version has this subscription model, which renders the app absolutely useless. You literally can’t see the allergen markers AT ALL. I’m not paying a subscription fee for something I previously used for free. This is ridiculous. It’s also way too expensive for what it is and what you’re offering. I’m so done with this app

So glitchy. This app is so glitchy I cannot believe they charge $60/month for it. You can search the same thing one moment and yield zero results, and the next will populate the results you were looking for.

don’t use it for free. IMO dangerously inaccurate after the paid version came out. Since then, website says ingredients that I know I am allergic to are safe. Dashboard now has a pay wall so there is no option to verify on site. Luckily I have kept my allergist’s lists on hand. App rarely worked, anyway, but the website used to be great. No point in using affiliate links as information is unreliable now. Uninstalling.

Customer Service Is Terrible. I thought this app was great until they tried to make you pay for it. Once the upgrade happened, my allergies were re-classified as safe when reviewing a product when in fact it is not. I have reached out five times via customer service contact online with limited responses and the team saying they are not getting my emails. I have asked for a number to call or a different email but they will not communicate with me. I am beyond upset as I purchased items based on their app that ended up NOT being safe and I just want some answers as to what happened on their end. I’m glad I never purchased a subscription.

Great concept but…. This could be a fabulous tool but much of the information is out of date. They need to modernize their way of collecting and maintaining data so that we can make informed choices. 

It was a poor decision to start charging for premium account when data is so out of date. I constantly find outdated ingredient listings and there is no way to ‘report a problem’ in app. Emailing the support team (of 1 person) is highly inefficient and likely perpetuates the data quality issue.

A Godsend. I’m not one to review apps but I had to come and leave a review and say that this app has helped me find truly 100% hypoallergenic products. It’s no way I’d be on the mend without this app. I’m truly thankful!

Not trustworthy anymore. As someone who has extreme skin allergies, I found this app in 2017. I depended 100%
It would tell me not safe, list ingredients them tell me which ingredient I was allergic to. NOW I have to pay to get that information??? I scanned a sunscreen and it was “under review”. But it was listed when I searched by name and it was safe. I questioned but NEVER got a response 
I was so delighted when I found the app, now I don’t trust it. I will not recommend it

Serious ALL the nicknames are taken?????
Poor customer service. The idea is great here but the execution is bad. I have been trying to get a hold of customer service for over a month as I paid for the subscription however it isn’t working.
Lists. Great product and use the app all the time

Less and less useful: no custom filters now?. Not what it’s cracked up to be, and less useful with every release. Most products labeled “safe” for me are unavailable or discontinued, with broken links. SO much duplicate and outdated information. More often than not when I scan a barcode at the store, it’s not in the database and I’m asked to add the product. Each update revokes features that I use: first which ingredients were unsafe. Now I can’t make a custom filter, I can only use the (extremely conservative) code provided by my doctor? No. That’s just nonsense. Why can’t I make a customized filter anymore? It’s unrealistic: my doctor insists I avoid a huge list of ingredients, then refers me to a commercial app as my only resource, then this app restricts and gatekeeps all of this (poorly-organized, *user-maintained*) data, making it increasingly difficult for me to literally heal. So, why would I shell out for the “premium” version, where is the value? I already can’t find what I need, and SkinSafe shows no signs of improvement. Frustrating and discouraging.

So far so good. Honestly, I have no complaints other than the price. I hate that the subscription is so expensive, but I understand the need for sustainability, especially to continually improve the app development. Skin allergies are tough to navigate but this app makes it much easier. 

Any way you guys can come off this price? My son is 3 and has severe allergies, so I’ll obviously be using this app long term, and then when he’s of age he will then use it.

Losing features with every update. Every time this app updates a different feature is locked for premium users only. Stuff that was free when I first downloaded the app at my dermatologist’s suggestion is now locked and I must pay a premium fee to access it. It’s annoying enough that I’m considering uninstalling and just using the paper list of safe products that my doctor gave me. I used this app due to the extensive contact allergens I’m allergic to but I’m not going to pay to use features that were once free. It’s kind of a bummer considering this was meant to help identify safe products but pretty soon you’ll have to pay to even do that.

Premier not applied-ghosted by customer service. I’ve used skinsafe (free version) for years - joins in 2018/2019 and the customer service was amazing. I tried the premier trial, didn’t extend but recently decided to purchase later on. I bought through the app and it didn’t apply. I reached out to customer service and they replied to say Apple deals with the billing but send me a screenshot of your confirmation/receipt and a screenshot of my skinsafe account page to see how it could be applied. Absolute Game Changer For Sensitive Skin.. This app is exactly what I’ve been searching for. Created in tandem with the Mayo Clinic (one of the most trusted medical research centres in the world) and using AI technology, it enables anyone with skin contact allergies to search their extensive database of products to screen for common allergens. This part of the app is free and you can screen common allergens like “SLS free”, “paraben free”, fragrance free” etc.

If you’ve done patch testing previously, or know exactly which ingredients you’re allergic to you can send these to the developers if you pay for premium access. This enables the app company to generate a personal code and so you can filter products out by the exact ingredients you have personally tested positive to.

On top of this they can adjust the sensitivity of your allergens to also screen out all ingredients derivative of your known allergens or those likely to cause the same reaction. This is brilliant as there are so many names for many ingredients and it means you to learn about your allergens and work out what else to avoid.

Better yet (especially for this Aussie as many products listed are not available here) you can upload products with ingredient listings (either by sending a URL of a web page that lists the ingredients or by product packaging photos) and they upload them into the database. As a premium member they give priority upload and the first couple I sent were there within 24 hours!

Best $59 (for a year access) I’ve spent in ages and WAY cheaper than buying products I can’t use and only getting skin irritation for my trouble.

Every dermatologist should be recommending this to their patients.
